analysis.title: [GSX] Global Reflections
key_insights: GS FICC & Equities desk says the post-election relief rally lasted under 24 hours and AI/geopolitics fatigue resumed. It recommends a barbell of selective AI trades and defensive, immediate FCF/income generators.
The Power theme (GSENEPOW) is up post-midterms, IPPs (GSXUIPPS) are +15% off their lows, and Hyperscalers (GSXUHYPR) still offer defensive AI exposure.

Last week's technical washout set up an AI rebound, but appetite to digest NVDA-specific issues was short-lived. Investors describe the early-week price action as a potential thematic bear market rally.

Whether the sell-off is a buy-the-dip or the start of a regime shift in equity leadership depends on whether the market is in an earnings bubble. The desk says certain pockets are clearly over-earning.

Valuations in some pockets imply excessive downward revisions to 2027 earnings. The desk says a return of fundamental AI confidence could double memory stocks, since the market sits at the left tail of 2027 Memory outcomes.
To balance AI exposure, the desk likes adding longs on SPXXAI, which has outperformed SPX over the last year and held up better in last week's sell-off.

The market's biggest index weights lack free cash flow and non-cash earnings are a larger share of earnings growth, so FCF is scarce and matters more. The desk expects high-FCF generators to keep being rewarded in a higher-for-longer rate environment.
Preferred expression is long the US High vs Low FCF pair (GSPUFCFP), where recent outperformance came equally from the long and short legs. Quality's strength has come mostly from the short leg.
The European High vs Low FCF pair (GSPEFCFP) lagged the US version over summer but has started to catch up aggressively, and the desk expects that to continue in coming weeks.
Related short theme: the Lending Sensitive basket (GSXULEND), covering businesses with capital needs that may be crowded out by other capital market demands.

Long China high-dividend trade is working. The China High Dividend basket (GSXACHHN) is up 8pp over 3m while CSI 300 is down 15pp. It is concentrated in Banks and Energy/Utility stocks, supported by National Team buying.

Listed Chinese companies have returned more than Rmb2tn a year via dividends and buybacks in each of the past three years. GS Asia favors Value, Dividend and Cash Return over longer-duration growth given wide US-China yield differentials.

Europe has one of the lowest betas to the AI trade (SXXP 2y daily beta to GSPUARTI below 0.05), and the desk expects investors to return to the region for AI diversification. The broad European bull case still depends on a US-Iran resolution.
EU High and Stable Margins basket (GSXEMARG) has low or no AI correlation, a defensive skew against geopolitical shocks, and has just started to break out versus the market.

French Domestics (GSXEFRDO) are up 10% from October lows, which the desk calls premature. It sees the downtrend resuming on difficult credit conditions, high political uncertainty and S&P's rating review on Nov 27.

Momentum regime is shifting. Correlation between 12m momentum (GSPRHIMO) and 3m momentum (GSPRHMO3) is now negative, and AI names in the short leg of 3m and 6m momentum have risen sharply. Infotech was net sold in 3m and 6m momentum but slightly bought in 12m.
Momentum 60-day volatility is 3.5x that of SPX, so rotations and reversals are likely until the market settles on new long-term leadership.
